watch_list.title: Nvidia Investor Sentiment
watch_list.rationale: Despite strong revenue, institutional managers filed 13F-HR reports, suggesting potential re-evaluation of positions. A clarification or further insight into these filings would help understand the underlying sentiment.
watch_list.trigger: Further details or analysis on the 13F-HR filings from institutional investors regarding Nvidia holdings emerge, explaining the cautious sentiment.

watch_list.title: AMD EPYC 'Venice' Production Ramp
watch_list.rationale: AMD is preparing to ramp up production of its next-gen EPYC 'Venice' processor, which could significantly impact its market share and revenue in the server CPU market. Monitoring the actual progress and announcements regarding this ramp-up is crucial.
watch_list.trigger: AMD announces specific timelines or initial production volumes for its EPYC 'Venice' processor.

watch_list.title: AMD Investment with Taiwan Partners
watch_list.rationale: AMD's commitment to invest over US$10 billion with Taiwanese supply-chain partners indicates strategic long-term plans for chip manufacturing and supply chain stability. Monitoring the specifics of these investments can shed light on future production capabilities and regional dependence.
watch_list.trigger: AMD or its Taiwanese partners release details or updates on the allocation and utilization of the US$10 billion investment.

watch_list.title: GPU Cloud Pricing Dynamics
watch_list.rationale: The reported A100 GPU instances at $0.66/hr suggest competitive pricing pressure in the GPU cloud market, which could impact margins for hardware providers and cloud service operators. Further market data on competitor pricing will show the full impact.
watch_list.trigger: New pricing data from major GPU cloud providers or reports on market share shifts due to pricing become available.
